B is slightly better on the requirement to name each frame for both tools. It gives both ids for every frame it names, including the frames where GPU end comes before start, and it adds explicit directions for finding them in the MicroProfiler UI. It also flags the trap of adding nested GC time to the script scopes. Neither attempt cites the Present or waitUntilCompleted values.
